llm.summary: This skill is a narrow review prompt for finding over-engineering in diffs and shows no hidden code, persistence, credential use, or unsafe actions.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and artifact content match: it asks the agent to review diffs for unnecessary complexity and report concise deletion or simplification suggestions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.label: Instruction Scope

dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem mutation, network access, credentials, local indexing, or external tool authority beyond reading the user-provided diff context.

llm.guidance: This is safe to install as a lightweight code-review style prompt. Expect it to intentionally produce terse suggestions about deleting or simplifying code, and use a normal review pass for bugs, security, or performance concerns.
